title: Nine Pages of Finding
subtitle: 线索与提示 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 线索与提示（做人与做事·推理与判断）
meta: 主题语境：线索与提示（做人与做事·推理与判断）　|　核心词汇：clue　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clue 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to find ① clue she could not read, and she said the finding was the whole of the lesson. The ② clue, meaning the sign and not the answer, was nine pages back and was found by whoever came last; clue, she said, is the only thing in a case that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ clue in that case had the same shape, and the ④ clue at the end, meaning the one the inspector kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever found properly. Clue, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ clue was the whole of the puzzle, meaning the hint it carried and not the sign. The ⑥ clue, meaning the hint and not any of that, is the only thing in a puzzle that everybody follows and nobody questions; clue, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a sign and a hint. She said the hint is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ clue had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the shape. The ⑧ clue of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pages and eleven years of finding; clue, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ clue I remember is the one at the end, which was found in 1971 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ clue, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being found; every clue, she said, is a hint that has agreed to look like a sign. She said the hint was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 线索（指那个迹象本身，与那个答案相对）
C. 固定搭配：find a clue 找到一条线索
D. n. 线索（指那桩案子里每一条）
E. n. 线索（指末尾那一条）
F. n. 提示（抽象：它承载的那个暗示）
G. n. 那个暗示（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The clue, meaning the sign and not the answer
clue was the whole of the puzzle
the clue had become a number in a report
The clue of the whole thing
A clue, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: find a clue 意为“找到一条线索”，1951 年母亲被派去找她读不懂的那条线索。
clue 意为“线索、迹象”，指那个迹象本身而不是那个答案，在九页之前，由最后来的人找到。
clue 指那桩案子里每一条线索，每一条都是同样的形状。
clue 指末尾那一条（探长保留的那一条），是唯一有人认真找过的。
clue 意为“提示”，抽象指它承载的那个暗示，父亲说 clue 就是那道谜题的全部。
clue 为抽象用法，指那个暗示本身，是一道谜题里人人都顺着走、却没人质疑的东西。
clue 意为“线索、迹象”，到 1966 年这条 clue 成了报告里的一个数字。
clue 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九页纸和十一年的寻找。
clue 意为“线索”，我记得的是末尾那一条，1971 年找到，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
clue 为抽象总称，祖母说一条线索是唯一会因为被认真寻找而变好的东西。
